sections.title: Physics and Music Combined Major Credit Requirement
heading_path: Physics and Music Combined Major Credit Requirement

entries.text: Complete a minimum of 98 semester hours in the major.

Students must maintain at least a 2.667 GPA (B– average) in the requirements of the music half of the combined major and also complete all required music courses with grades of at least C. Students who fail to meet the above standards will be placed on departmental probation; those who remain on probation for two consecutive semesters will be dropped from the major.

major_name: Physics and Music with Concentration in Music Technology
overview_text: The combined major in physics and music with concentration in music technology provides a strong foundation in classical and modern physics, along with the physics of acoustic and digital audio-related phenomena, and studies of the various physical phenomena including electromagnetism, dynamics, building blocks of matter, energy, and radiation. It also provides students with a solid background in the interdisciplinary application of creative audio technologies to a broad range of outcomes, including analog/digital systems, hardware and software design, musical instrument design, audio synthesis and signal processing, human-computer interaction, and innovative artistic applications of music technology. The combined major allows students to learn how physical principles influence sound production and propagation.
